title: Soft budget: a handler running past the elicited budget fires cronStalled but the dispatcher does not terminate; every event record is metadata-only
description: The applying project elicits a soft-budget duration per handler (default 30 seconds; no floor). If a handler's observed duration crosses the budget, the dispatcher fires exactly one cronStalled lifecycle event with metadata-only payload {expression, scheduledTime, outcome, duration, softBudgetMs} at the moment the observed duration crosses the budget. The dispatcher NEVER terminates the handler on soft-budget breach; Cloudflare's platform-level termination remains the sole terminator per https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/. Every scheduled-side lifecycle event record on the sink carries only {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome, duration} plus optional numeric fields (softBudgetMs, deltaMs); handler input closures, PII fields and body bytes never cross the sink boundary.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.2). Ships as v1.0.0 of platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers.
